<set-variable name="rpcId" value="@{
            var raw = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? "";
            if (!raw.TrimStart().StartsWith("{")) { return JValue.CreateNull(); }
            var id = JObject.Parse(raw)["id"];
            return id ?? JValue.CreateNull();
        }" />
        <set-variable name="bridgeDeny" value="@{
            var tenant = (string)context.Variables["tenantKey"];
            if (!Regex.IsMatch(tenant ?? "", "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$")) { return "unknown_tenant"; }
            var tool = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName", "");
            var allowed = "{{orders-bridge-allowed-tools}}".Split(',').Select(t => t.Trim()).Where(t => t != "");
            return allowed.Contains(tool) ? "" : "not_entitled";
        }" />
